about:
Synteen Technical Fabrics was founded in 1998 in Lancaster, South Carolina. Initially serving the southeastern United States, the company expanded its reach across North America, Mexico, and the Caribbean. In a recent strategic move, Synteen was acquired by Maccaferri, Inc., a global construction and infrastructure group, while continuing to manufacture its products domestically in the United States.

The company operates a 40,000-square-foot facility where it produces uniaxial geogrids, biaxial geogrids, and high-strength woven fabrics. A team with over 75 years of combined experience oversees rigorous testing, continuous innovation, and responsiveness to customer feedback to maintain product quality and performance.

Synteen serves the geosynthetics industry, supplying solutions for civil construction, industrial construction, and infrastructure projects. Its customer base includes contractors, engineers, and distributors involved in sectors such as energy and natural resources, oil and gas, and building construction, with applications ranging from roadways and retaining walls to erosion control.

The company differentiates itself by keeping manufacturing in the United States, contrasting with competitors that have outsourced production. It emphasizes rigorous testing, continuous innovation, and responsiveness to customer feedback as core pillars that keep it at the forefront of the geosynthetics industry.
